style.styleTitle: Scottish Everlastings Ltd Christmas Eucalyptus, Lambs Ear & Berry Wreath
style.toneOfVoice: Add a touch of natural elegance to your home with this artificial 56cm eucalyptus, lamb’s ear & berry wreath. Featuring soft, silvery lamb’s ear leaves, lush eucalyptus foliage, and subtle berry accents, it creates a beautifully textured display that complements any décor. Perfect for doors, walls, or mantelpieces, this wreath brings a calming, woodland-inspired charm indoors. Its neutral tones and realistic detailing make it versatile for year-round styling, from festive celebrations to everyday décor. Lightweight yet full of character, it’s easy to hang and designed to maintain its beauty over time. Bring a sophisticated touch to your home with this 56cm eucalyptus, lamb’s ear, and berry wreath—a timeless addition to any interior. Bring indoors during adverse weather conditions. Wreath width: 56cm. Wipe clean with a soft cloth.
